mapper.select: -- Count active user for manual consultation assignment validation. SELECT count(1) FROM users u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
-- Select active user primary key by public code for operator-facing forms. SELECT u.id FROM users u WHERE u.public_code = #{publicCode} AND u.status_code = 'ACTIVE'

-- Select consultation availability slots. SELECT pas.id AS slot_id, pas.partner_user_id, pas.start_at, pas.end_at, pas.status_code, pas.note, pas.created_at, pas.updated_at FROM partner_availability_slots pas
ORDER BY pas.start_at ASC, pas.id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count consultation availability slots. SELECT count(1) FROM partner_availability_slots pas

-- Select one consultation availability slot. SELECT pas.id AS slot_id, pas.partner_user_id, pas.start_at, pas.end_at, pas.status_code, pas.note, pas.created_at, pas.updated_at FROM partner_availability_slots pas WHERE pas.id = #{slotId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert partner consultation availability slot. INSERT INTO partner_availability_slots ( id, partner_user_id, start_at, end_at, status_code, note, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{slotId}, #{partnerUserId}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, 'OPEN', #{note}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Update consultation availability slot status. UPDATE partner_availability_slots SET status_code = #{statusCode}, note = COALESCE(#{note}, note), updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{slotId}
mapper.select:
-- Select consultation reservations with slot time. SELECT cr.id AS reservation_id, cr.public_code AS reservation_code, cr.slot_id, cr.member_user_id, member_user.public_code AS member_user_code, cr.partner_user_id, partner_user.public_code AS partner_user_code, cr.progress_id, ap.public_code AS progress_code, cr.verification_id, pv.public_code AS verification_code, pas.start_at, pas.end_at, cr.status_code, cr.request_note, cr.status_note, cr.confirmed_at, cr.canceled_at, cr.completed_at, cr.created_at, cr.updated_at FROM consultation_reservations cr LEFT JOIN partner_availability_slots pas ON pas.id = cr.slot_id INNER JOIN users member_user ON member_user.id = cr.member_user_id LEFT JOIN users partner_user ON partner_user.id = cr.partner_user_id LEFT JOIN application_progresses ap ON ap.id = cr.progress_id LEFT JOIN partner_verifications pv ON pv.id = cr.verification_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(pas.start_at, cr.created_at) DESC, cr.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count consultation reservations. SELECT count(1) FROM consultation_reservations cr LEFT JOIN partner_availability_slots pas ON pas.id = cr.slot_id

-- Select one consultation reservation with slot time. SELECT cr.id AS reservation_id, cr.public_code AS reservation_code, cr.slot_id, cr.member_user_id, member_user.public_code AS member_user_code, cr.partner_user_id, partner_user.public_code AS partner_user_code, cr.progress_id, ap.public_code AS progress_code, cr.verification_id, pv.public_code AS verification_code, pas.start_at, pas.end_at, cr.status_code, cr.request_note, cr.status_note, cr.confirmed_at, cr.canceled_at, cr.completed_at, cr.created_at, cr.updated_at FROM consultation_reservations cr LEFT JOIN partner_availability_slots pas ON pas.id = cr.slot_id INNER JOIN users member_user ON member_user.id = cr.member_user_id LEFT JOIN users partner_user ON partner_user.id = cr.partner_user_id LEFT JOIN application_progresses ap ON ap.id = cr.progress_id LEFT JOIN partner_verifications pv ON pv.id = cr.verification_id WHERE cr.id = #{reservationId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert consultation reservation request. INSERT INTO consultation_reservations ( id, slot_id, member_user_id, partner_user_id, progress_id, verification_id, status_code, request_note, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{reservationId}, #{slotId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{memberUserId}, #{partnerUserId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{progressId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{verificationId,jdbcType=OTHER}, 'REQUESTED', #{requestNote}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Update consultation reservation status. UPDATE consultation_reservations SET status_code = #{statusCode}, slot_id = COALESCE(#{slotId,jdbcType=OTHER}, slot_id), partner_user_id = COALESCE(#{partnerUserId,jdbcType=OTHER}, partner_user_id), status_note = #{note}, confirmed_at = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'CONFIRMED' THEN now() ELSE confirmed_at END, canceled_at = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'CANCELED' THEN now() ELSE canceled_at END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} IN ('COMPLETED', 'NO_SHOW') THEN now() ELSE completed_at END, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{reservationId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert consultation status history. INSERT INTO consultation_histories ( id, reservation_id, actor_user_id, before_status_code, after_status_code, note ) VALUES ( #{historyId}, #{reservationId}, #{actorUserId}, #{beforeStatusCode}, #{afterStatusCode}, #{note} )
mapper.select: -- Select application progress owner for reservation validation. SELECT ap.id AS progress_id, ap.member_user_id FROM application_progresses ap WHERE ap.id = #{progressId}
-- Select partner verification owner for reservation validation. SELECT pv.id AS verification_id, pv.member_user_id FROM partner_verifications pv WHERE pv.id = #{verificationId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert non-PII consultation audit log. INSERT INTO audit_logs ( actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
